explanation: A renewed agreement between God and his people, involving forgiveness of sins and a new inner relationship with God.
The name of the ancient Hebrew people, also referring to the twelve tribes that made up the nation of Israel in the Old Testament.
One of Israel's twelve tribes and a term often used to represent the entire Northern Kingdom of Israel.
The holy city and capital of ancient Israel, the center of Jewish faith and worship.
Another name for Jerusalem, especially used to refer to the spiritual significance of the city as God's dwelling place.
The action performed by God when he brings his people together again after a time of separation or exile.
The process by which God restores the relationship with his people and heals their land and community.
Symbolizes the inner being of a person, including thoughts, feelings, and will. In Jeremiah 31 it represents the place where God's law is written.
God's instructions and commands to his people, given through Moses and other prophets in the Old Testament.
